description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the Placeholders class, testing its placeholder detection methods using string inputs.

classes.name: PlaceholdersTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing placeholder detection logic in the Placeholders utility class.

methods.name: containsReturnsTrueWhenInputContainsPlaceholder
methods.description: Tests that the method detects a placeholder present in the input string.

methods.name: containsReturnsTrueWhenInputContainsLegacyPlaceholder
methods.description: Tests detection of a legacy placeholder pattern in the input string.

methods.name: containsReturnsTrueWhenInputContainsBothNewAndLegacyPlaceholders
methods.description: Checks detection of both new and legacy placeholders appearing together.

methods.name: containsReturnsFalseWhenInputContainsPlaceholderStartOnly
methods.description: Verifies that incomplete placeholder start pattern is not falsely detected.

methods.name: containsReturnsFalseWhenInputContainsPlaceholderEndOnly
methods.description: Verifies that incomplete placeholder end pattern is not falsely detected.

methods.name: containsReturnsFailsWhenInputDoesNotContainAnyPlaceholder
methods.description: Ensures that strings without placeholders return false.
